gateApp.codeOrLink: Namba ya kiungo au kiungo chote
gateApp.linkQrHelp: Mlinda lango askani QR hii kwa kamera ya simu yake, au afungue kiungo. Mpe PIN kwa njia nyingine.
gateApp.linkQrAlt: Msimbo wa QR wa kiungo cha lango; namba {code}

gateJoinPage.title: Umealikwa kulinda lango
gateJoinPage.body: Lango linaendeshwa kwenye programu ya {brand} ya Android. Huhitaji akaunti: namba hii ya kiungo na PIN uliyopewa na mwenye harusi zinatosha.
gateJoinPage.step1: Pakua na usakinishe programu ya {brand} (Android 8 au mpya zaidi).
gateJoinPage.step2: Rudi kwenye ukurasa huu ubonyeze "Fungua kwenye programu", au fungua programu uchague "Ninalinda lango" na uweke namba {code}.
gateJoinPage.step3: Weka PIN uliyopewa. Orodha ya wageni itapakuliwa, kisha unaweza kuskani hata bila mtandao.
gateJoinPage.trust: Hatutakuomba nenosiri wala namba ya siri ya simu yako. PIN ya lango unapewa na mwenye harusi tu.

gateApp.codeOrLink: Link code or the whole link
gateApp.linkQrHelp: The gate agent scans this QR with their phone camera, or opens the link. Give them the PIN separately.

gateJoinPage.title: You've been asked to run the gate
gateJoinPage.body: The gate runs in the {brand} Android app. You don't need an account: this link code and the PIN the hosts gave you are enough.
gateJoinPage.step1: Download and install the {brand} app (Android 8 or newer).
gateJoinPage.step2: Come back to this page and tap "Open in the app", or open the app, choose "I'm running the gate" and enter code {code}.
gateJoinPage.step3: Enter the PIN you were given. The guest list downloads, then you can scan even without a network.
gateJoinPage.trust: We will never ask for a password or your phone's PIN. The gate PIN only comes from the hosts.
